board: PTSolns I2Connect: KXTJ3-1057 3-axis accelerometer module (Qwiic-compatible, V2.0)
reason: Check passed on ESP32 and Pico (spec, wiring, design checks, breadboard, simulator, PCB, footprint, LCSC); 12-bit left-justified output modelled with shift 4 at 1024 counts/g per the datasheet. SparkFun sells no KXTJ3 Qwiic board, so the Qwiic-compatible PTSolns module was modelled; its header order comes from the PTSolns README, and the 10 kOhm board pull-up value is an assumption because PTSolns has not published a schematic.
breakoutPinoutSource: https://github.com/PTSolns/I2Connect_KXTJ3-1057 (README: header pinout INT, SCL, SDA, 3V3, GND)
